title: Irrigation Tracking Log
subtitle: Farm Irrigation: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Irrigation Tracking Log covers field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response. The irrigation coordinator records Farm Irrigation events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Irrigation Tracking Log keeps Farm Irrigation exceptions visible until the irrigation coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Irrigation Tracking Log at water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary. Document field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response identity before Farm Irrigation begins. Compare field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response findings with stated Farm Irrigation criteria; route unresolved Farm Irrigation issues to farm water-system reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Farm Irrigation, identify responsible parties, water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary, and the linked field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response source.

fields.label: Water source, permit or allocation reference, and pump
Zone, valve, line, meter, and controller

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Farm Irrigation facts for field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farm Irrigation tracked controls
items: Leak, blockage, emitter, sprinkler, and uniformity
Runoff, erosion, ponding, and neighboring impact

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: For Farm Irrigation, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Irrigation Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Reading or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Farm Irrigation when water authority, supply, equipment, delivered volume, runoff, or field-impact concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Farm Irrigation proof and route unresolved field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response scope to irrigation coordinator.
